'''2000 Death Star II Pre-Release (Normal)''' was a Star Wars CCG pre-release held in Normal, IL on 24 June 2000. [[Geoff Snider]] won it. It is known from Geoff Snider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d930">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-25-ds2-pre-release-normal-ill-6-24-99d930/ ds2-pre-release-normal-ill-6-24-99], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 25 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-25-ds2-pre-release-normal-ill-6-24-99d930/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Normal, IL
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 90
* '''Winner:''' [[Geoff Snider]]
